Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

The `--c128-page-size` argument controls the NPU DSV4 C128 KV cache physical
page size. It must be a positive multiple of 16 (required by the Ascend sparse
attention operator), and its value must be wired through to the C128 KV pool's
`kernel_page_size`. These two invariants were previously only exercised
indirectly through e2e inference, with no focused unit coverage, so a regression
backed by a mis-wired or unvalidated page size could slip through CI.

## Modifications

- Add `TestC128PageSize` to `test_npu_ascend_dsv4_backend.py`:
  - `test_configured_page_size_reaches_npu_c128_kv_pool` asserts the configured
    value (16/32) is stored on the pool and forwarded as `kernel_page_size` when
    `_make_kv_pool` builds the C128 pool.
  - `test_invalid_page_size_is_rejected` asserts non-positive and non-16-multiple
    values (0, -16, 1, 24) raise `ValueError`.
- Mock `sgl_kernel_npu.kvcacheio` alongside the other optional NPU modules so the
  test file imports cleanly when that submodule is unavailable.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — test-only change; no model forward or kernel code is modified.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — no inference or performance code paths changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit` .
- [x] Add unit tests according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests` .
- [ ] Update documentation according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations` .
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy`  and `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed` .
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance` .

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process` .
2. Get approvals from `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS`  and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests`  or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -18,6 +18,7 @@
     "torch_npu",
     "torch_npu.contrib",
     "sgl_kernel_npu",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.kvcacheio",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.attention",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.attention.sinks_attention",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.norm",
@@ -72,11 +73,57 @@ def _per_step_draft_out_cache_loc(out_cache_loc, batch_size, topk, num_steps):
     dsv4_state_payloads,
 )
 from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool import DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool
 from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_req_to_token_pool import (
     DSV4ReqToTokenTablesMixin,
 )
 
 
+class TestC128PageSize(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_configured_page_size_reaches_npu_c128_kv_pool(self):
+        for page_size in (16, 32):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(page_size=page_size),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.get_schedule",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(c128_page_size=page_size),
+                ),
+                patch.object(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, "__init__", return_value=None),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool"
+                ) as kv_pool_cls,
+            ):
+                pool = DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool()
+                pool.qk_nope_head_dim = 128
+                pool.qk_rope_head_dim = 64
+                pool._make_kv_pool(
+                    size=256,
+                    page_size=1,
+                    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    layer_num=1,
+                    device="cpu",
+                    enable_memory_saver=False,
+                    global_page_size=128,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(pool.c128_page_size, page_size)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    kv_pool_cls.call_args.kwargs["kernel_page_size"], page_size
+                )
+
+    def test_invalid_page_size_is_rejected(self):
+        for page_size in (0, -16, 1, 24):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(page_size=page_size),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.get_schedule",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(c128_page_size=page_size),
+                ),
+                patch.object(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, "__init__", return_value=None),
+            ):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "positive multiple of 16"):
+                    DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool()
+
+

     def _backend():
